  {"step":1,"file":"src/core/thread/energy_scan_server.cpp","function":"EnergyScanServer::HandleRequest","line":94,"var":"mask","code":"VerifyOrExit((mask = MeshCoP::ChannelMaskTlv::GetChannelMask(aMessage)) != 0);","note":"Attacker-controlled CoAP POST payload is accepted as an energy-scan request and the Channel Mask TLV is parsed from it."},
  {"step":2,"file":"src/core/meshcop/meshcop_tlvs.cpp","function":"ChannelMaskTlv::GetChannelMask(const Message &)","line":252,"var":"channelMaskTlv","code":"SuccessOrExit(GetTlv(aMessage, kChannelMask, sizeof(channelMaskTlv), channelMaskTlv));","note":"The TLV is copied out of the message into a fixed-size ChannelMaskTlv object before validation."},
  {"step":3,"file":"src/core/meshcop/meshcop_tlvs.cpp","function":"ChannelMaskTlv::GetChannelMask(const Message &)","line":253,"var":"mask","code":"mask = channelMaskTlv.GetChannelMask();","note":"Parsing continues by walking the embedded channel-mask entries inside the copied TLV."},
  {"step":4,"file":"src/core/meshcop/meshcop_tlvs.cpp","function":"ChannelMaskTlv::GetChannelMask(void) const","line":228,"var":"entry","code":"while (entry != NULL)","note":"The loop iterates over each ChannelMaskEntry using GetNext(), which computes the next pointer from the current entry's declared size."},
  {"step":5,"file":"src/core/meshcop/meshcop_tlvs.cpp","function":"ChannelMaskEntryBase::GetNext(const Tlv *) const","line":160,"var":"entry","code":"const uint8_t *entry = reinterpret_cast<const uint8_t *>(this) + GetEntrySize();","note":"GetEntrySize() uses the attacker-controlled mMaskLength field, so an oversized length advances the pointer beyond the actual entry data."},
  {"step":6,"file":"src/core/meshcop/meshcop_tlvs.cpp","function":"ChannelMaskEntry::GetMask","line":151,"var":"mMask","code":"uint32_t GetMask(void) const { return Reverse32(HostSwap32(mMask)); }","note":"The parser dereferences the ChannelMaskEntry as a full 32-bit mask even when the entry layout is shorter than expected, causing an out-of-bounds read."},
  {"step":7,"file":"src/core/meshcop/meshcop_tlvs.hpp","function":"ChannelMaskEntry::IsValid","line":1510,"var":"GetMaskLength()","code":"bool IsValid(void) const { return GetMaskLength() == sizeof(mMask); }","note":"The root cause is that validation only checks the mask length for exact equality, but the parser path in GetChannelMask() can still reach the sink through malformed entry chaining before a safe stop."}
]
p.write_text(__import__('json').dumps(trace, indent=2))
print(p)
